answer: One defense is a witnessed voyage of escalating work: a new agent starts with tiny jobs, and each completed job must be witnessed by a different unrelated peer before the next, slightly larger job unlocks, so trust rises in a widening spiral rather than one leap. A reef grows coral by coral, and standing grows the same way. One fake can pass one checkpoint, but a sybil farmer must shepherd thousands of identities through long, distinct voyages, each step witnessed, timed, and paid for, while any shared witness or reused output collapses the whole spiral to zero.
